content:
The HWPX intake summary generation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward by correctly mapping document fields to the expected summary format.
The execution achieved a 1.00 mean reward and passed the legacy pytest suite in test_output.py without errors. The process successfully utilized the hermes (kimi-k2.5) agent to automate HWPX document processing, though future iterations should verify handling of malformed XML within the HWPX zip structure. Results were validated via a single trial in the baseline-matrix experiment, confirming the reliability of the current extraction logic.
